card.text: Explore 137P/Shoemaker–Levy 2 through a shape approximation based on published lightcurve models.

introduction.text: Shoemaker–Levy 2 turns once in about eight hours. Its changing brightness suggests a rounded nucleus, slightly flattened along the spin axis.

model.title: Inferred shape
model.summary: A smooth approximation of the published proportions. Two pole orientations fit the lightcurves; this uses Model 1. The grid marks missing surface imagery. Rotation phase is illustrative.
